title: ApprovalArtifactV1
description: Signed attestation that a human reviewer approved a specific action. Verified by the evaluate path before issuing a permit_token. The agent cannot self-declare authority; the artifact is bound to the exact action via action_hash, signed by a trusted issuer, and replay-protected via nonce. Wire-stable as `approval_artifact.v1`.

approver_grant_assertion.description: Optional, additive (atlasent-api#3863 / #3876, 2026-10-03). The console-signed approver_grant_assertion.v1 that authorized this approval under the atlasent_approver_grant basis. An alternative to identity_assertion, never alongside it. Covered by the artifact signature. The runtime admits it only from an approval issuer whose trusted-issuer entry declares identity_basis "approver_grant", and only inside an approval reevaluation of this exact approval; artifacts without this field validate and verify exactly as before.

not.description: identity_assertion and approver_grant_assertion are alternatives: an artifact carrying both is rejected by the runtime verifier.
